title: tc-tool-call-group
description: Several tool calls folded into one line: "Used 3 tools · 2.4s". The cards go in a `slot="list"` child (see above).

label.description: Label once all calls are done – defaults to "Used 3 tools"

runningLabel.description: Label while any call is running

duration.description: Total duration in ms – otherwise the sum of the cards' durations, or the time measured while running

open.description: Expanded. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()
